annotations.title: Nearby lakes, coast, peaks, parks and attractions

description: Notable named places near an address, grouped: lakes and reservoirs, rivers, coast and beaches, islands, mountains, national parks, parks and nature reserves, golf, ski and marinas, museums and attractions. Each with miles, direction and (by default) drive minutes. Says when the site is on the water or inside a national park, measured from the real OpenStreetMap outline. Source Wikidata (CC0). US and UK.

address.description: Street address with town and ZIP or postcode, e.g. "7090 State Highway 80, Cooperstown, NY 13326" or "Ambleside LA22 9BB". Not needed when lat and lon are given.

categories.description: Limit to these groups. Default all.

country.description: Optional hint for the address lookup.

drive_minutes.description: Add drive minutes to the closest places (one router call). Default true.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (use with lon instead of address).
